newsitem.title: USA: Nellcor Puritan says Q1 EPS to drop.
newsitem.headline: Nellcor Puritan says Q1 EPS to drop.

text.p: Nellcor Puritan Bennett Inc said Thursday it expects to report first quarter earnings of between $0.21 and $0.24 per share, which would represent a drop from the same period the year before.
In last year's first quarter, the company posted earnings of $0.25 per share.

Nellcor, which makes products for diagnosing, monitoring and treating respiratory-impaired patients, said the results were affected largely by its home-care business, where sales of oxygen therapy products lagged, and from a switch in sales of Infrasonics products from independent distributors to an in-house staff.
Vacancies in its U.S. hospital sales force also resulted in hospital business revenue that was below its expectations, the company said.
Nellcor said it expects revenues for the first quarter of between $160 million and $162 million.
In the same period the year before, the company had revenues of $162.5 million.
